subject: SIG Q&A — Etran log sourcing & artifact roundup
messages:
From: Ava Brooks <ava.brooks@etran.io>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Etran Security Team <security@etran.io>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG intake — log samples and CAIQ follow-ups

Hi Sean,

Thanks for making time to help us with the SIG/CAIQ review. We scheduled a 45-minute intake slot on Jun 10 but wanted to surface a couple of asks in advance so the call is productive: 

- Could you confirm which logging artifacts you can reasonably provide for a scoped run (application access logs, audit trail for config changes, KV-store access traces)?
- We typically request a 48–72 hour sample window in UTC — can you confirm retention windows and whether we can pull a short run for the sample?
- If you have a draft CAIQ/answers PDF, please send ahead so our reviewers can pre-read.

Also: we will need a point of contact for any redaction questions and an expected ETA on delivery so we can align internal reviewers.

Thanks,
Ava Brooks
Security Program Manager | Etran
ava.brooks@etran.io

--
Attachment: etran_sig_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet with requested scopes)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Brooks <ava.brooks@etran.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — log samples and CAIQ follow-ups

Hi Ava — thanks for the note and the pre-read. Quick answers up front, then details below: 

1) Artifacts we can provide for a scoped 72-hour window: application access logs (token-level), control-plane audit trail (config changes, role grants), and a truncated KV-cache access trace showing prefix hits (no raw user content).
2) Retention: operational logs are retained 90 days in hot storage; we can carve a 72-hour extract on request. For the sample we can provide redacted entries and an indexed CSV manifest.
3) Draft CAIQ: attached is the CAIQ draft ("etran_caiq-draft.pdf").

Action items and owners: 
- I will produce the log-sample manifest + redacted extracts by EOD Jun 8 (owner: me).
- Marissa will coordinate the transfer method and confirm whether Etran prefers SFTP or a signed Drive link (owner: marissa_cole).
- Irene will prepare a short README explaining redaction rules and fields (owner: irene_choi).

If anything here looks off, flag it and we can adjust before the intake call. Attaching the CAIQ draft and initial manifest stub.

Cheers,
Sean
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai

--
Attachments: etran_caiq-draft.pdf; log-sample-manifest.csv
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 15:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: SIG intake — logistics (internal)

Quick internal note — forwarding Ava's scope for clarity. Operational notes: 

- For transfer, Etran prefers a temporary signed Drive folder (they flagged SFTP only if high-volume). I'll set up a folder and share a write-protected link.
- I'll request access logs be exported as gzipped CSVs with the following columns: timestamp, principal, action, resource, result, request_id. Limit PII to opaque ids.
- Sean: confirm the extract query you plan to run (time range + services filtered).
- Irene: can you draft the README describing the redaction mapping (what we replace with tokens) and include the sampling method so reviewers can reproduce in-house?

I'll put a calendar reminder to drop the share link when Sean confirms the extract.

Marissa
Security Operations Lead | Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: redwood-intake-notes.txt (internal checklist)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Brooks <ava.brooks@etran.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG intake — log samples and CAIQ follow-ups

Hi Ava — confirmation and next steps: 

Thanks for the scope doc — this is straightforward. We will deliver the following by EOD Jun 8 (UTC):

- log-sample-manifest.csv (CSV manifest listing files and sample counts) -- attached to this thread.
- Redacted extracts (gzipped CSVs) covering 2027-05-20T00:00:00Z to 2027-05-23T23:59:59Z (72-hour window). Redaction: user ids and email addresses replaced with consistent tokens; request payloads omitted.
- CAIQ draft (attached) for your reviewers to pre-read.
- README.md describing extraction queries, redaction rules, and how to validate record counts.

Transfer method: Marissa will create a read-only Drive folder and post a signed link; we will upload manifests and gzips there. Please confirm if the Drive link is acceptable or if you require SFTP.

Call prep for Jun 10 intake (45 min):
- 10m: introductions + scope alignment
- 20m: artifact walkthrough (we will share screen to show sample rows and redaction approach)
- 10m: CAIQ walkthrough and outstanding controls
- 5m: next steps and SLAs for follow-up evidence

If that agenda looks good, we'll keep the slot. Otherwise propose changes.

See you on the call — Sean

--
Attachments: log-sample-manifest.csv; etran_caiq-draft.pdf
